A '''[[Tapani]] commitment band''' was a ring that was worn by married [[Tapani]] individuals to symbolize their commitment to their spouse. Following her marriage to [[Yaru Korsin]], [[Seelah Korsin]], wore a commitment band, on a finger which bore the [[Korsin family]] seal. Millennia later, in [[2975 BBY]], [[Iliana Hilts]] worse the same ring during her marriage with the new [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]] in order to reconcile Seelah's contributions to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
